rights.licence: ECB copyright: free use, the ECB cited as the source

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10. The ECB's copyright: users "may make free use of the information obtained directly from" the website, which "must appear accurately and the ECB must be cited as the source"; information sold inside documents must be said to be free of charge on the ECB's website, before payment and at each access; information modified by the user (seasonal adjustment, growth rates) must say so; ECB Working and Occasional Papers excepted. The Data Portal's API pages (overview, data, status codes) state no rate limit nor quota and no key: rateLimits unknown. Status codes: 200, 304 (If-Modified-Since), 400, 404 no results, 406, 500, 501, 503. Seen on 2026-11-10: the gateway answering 504 now and then (an UnavailableException), the dataflow list answering only with detail=allstubs.
